Type

The display/body ramp, rendered in the app's real shipped font files.

React Native cannot synthesise weights — every weight is its own family. There is no font-weight: 600 here. Ask for t.display(600) or t.body(700); a spec that says "semibold" without naming the resolver does not port.
The headline family is user-switchable (Quicksand — the shipped default — plus Baloo 2 and Fredoka). t.display(w) resolves to whichever the user picked, so never name a headline family directly. Body is always Nunito.
